# SCI-MAP v0.2/r0.3 empty-support product outcome owner disposition

Status: **selected candidate disposition attributed to the 2026-09-08 owner
directive; final acceptance of the exact r0.3 candidate remains pending**.

When a valid applied observation support policy yields
`S_out = empty set`, or a valid applied coadd support policy yields
`S_out_coadd = empty set`, record:

| Field | Exact value |
| --- | --- |
| application state | `applied_no_support_authorized_output_rows` |
| MAP attempt outcome | `not_produced` |
| MAP product realization | absent |
| cause | `no_support_authorized_output_rows` |

Retain the request, effective, observation-resolved, and applied stages; exact
parent and plan; coefficient, projection, support, role, and profile
identities; `Q_star`, thresholds, and support predicates; proof that the
authorized output-row set is empty; attempt identity; cause; and provenance.
The admitted empty-population convention remains exactly `Q_star = 0` for
`N = 0`. It does not identify a selected population element and does not mean
a zero-sky measurement.

The record has no realized MAP signal product or completion marker. It
publishes no dense zero map, zero-sky measurement, valid ordinary signal
plane, coadd member without scientific rows, or fabricated response or
covariance plane. The directive selected no immutable empty-row scientific
bundle alternative.

This rule is prospective. The r0.3 candidate profile and route are presently
unevaluable and no applied, realized, failed, or not-produced application
attempt for a current object is asserted by this package.
